title: About
summary: About Allen Technical Solutions, our approach, values and the people behind the work.
keywords: about company team founder story mission values approach
text: Who we are Built by an engineer, for people who build Allen Technical Solutions is led by Stephen D. Allen, an engineering and controls leader with 26+ years of experience across automotive, industrial and transportation engineering. Stephen has led global engineering teams, managed complex technical programs, and built real-time control systems, calibration strategies and automated test environments. He is known for reducing technical risk, improving product quality and turning customer requirements into engineering solutions that scale. B.S. Electrical & Communication Engineering, 3.92 GPA Six Sigma Green Belt projects in release and test processes Cybersecurity subject-matter expert for controls software releases Five years supporting OEMs across Central Europe from Germany Based in Indianapolis, Indiana. Connect on LinkedIn . Experience Career highlights 2025 – present Systems & Controls Engineering Specialist, Project Manager TRP Laboratories. Real-time test controls for automotive chassis and test cells; technical lead for controls, simulation, DAQ and software releases. 2024 – 2025 Engineering Consultant Independent consulting on audio and video projects and custom test instrumentation. 2005 – 2024 Cummins Inc. Embedded Controls Team Leader, Customer Engineering Technical Specialist (Germany), Controls Integration Leader, Controls Automated Test Leader, Senior Controls Test Engineer and Systems Engineer. Our approach How every project runs Listen Understand the real problem, not just the requested feature. Specify Write down requirements and acceptance criteria together. Deliver Build in visible increments with regular check-ins. Stand behind it Warranty period, documentation and ongoing support. Values What we hold ourselves to Integrity Honest estimates, and we tell you when something isn't worth building. Precision Measured results and work that is checked before it ships. Clarity Plain-language updates and documentation you can use. Craft Pride in clean designs, clean code and lasting solutions.

text: Knowledge base Frequently asked questions How do I request a quote? Use the contact form or book a discovery call. We reply within one business day. What payment methods do you accept? Credit and debit cards, PayPal, and ACH bank transfer. See Billing . How do I log in to the client portal? Use the Client Login link at the top of any page. Contact support if you need a password reset. What's included in a Website Care Plan? Core and plugin updates, daily backups, uptime monitoring, security scans and an hour of content edits each month. Do you sign NDAs? Yes, we're happy to sign a mutual NDA before discussing project details. Who owns the code and drawings? You do. Ownership transfers on final payment, as written in every proposal.
